scope: Fresh independent prospective semantic/feasibility review of revised public design, with original raw BRIEF/API MUST preservation and approved nine-state/source-only amendment

approval.rationale: All frozen mechanical reconstruction and sampled business semantics succeed, but four original/revised MUST coverage gaps require prospective index/route revision before approval. No product defect is alleged or supplied.

mechanical_checks.generic_method_support: native_checks label/enabled/selected; accessibility_box control/semantic height/gap/inset; opaque source-backed native pixels; separately sourced visual questions; activation and caller_update dispatch guards were inspected and exercised without SDK.

feasibility_scope: Ordinary SwiftUI/Compose component and existing proposed runtime rule/method routes appear implementable on both platforms. This does not mean the complete MUST acceptance mapping is sufficient or that any native/source product fact passed. R1-R4 block design approval.

limits: Real separate band/Text AX allocation requires capability probe
Actual control geometry and native click/update dispatch require native evidence
Explicit original iOS 14 API compatibility route remains incomplete
Actual Compose semantic nodes/selected/disabled need native evidence
Paparazzi performs semantic OnClick rather than physical input; no physical touch-shape claim
Float32 viewport and dp geometry require actual native metadata

issues.title: Exact reusable public API is only partially covered
issues.rationale: The source index checks existence/location of a declared production component and caller-driven rendering, but contains no atomic review of the full Swift/Kotlin declaration contract. Bridge compilation exercises public constructors/component callability, yet not public stored-property access, Equatable/Identifiable conformance, Kotlin data-class/value shape, the omitted Modifier argument/default, or an explicit iOS 14 compatibility route. This leaves original API MUSTs outside the explicit approved indexes.
issues.required_revision: Add explicit independently typed source/API review obligations for the full declared exported API and a concrete iOS 14 compatibility verification route. Retain direct bridge/native build checks; do not treat source review as native behavior.

issues.title: Uncapped line configuration lacks an explicit route
issues.rationale: All eight rendered wrapping roles are properly split and source-backed. Their questions check complete text for fixed caller samples, which cannot establish the additional original source/configuration constraint "without line limits". No source-only audit proposition prohibits a finite line cap.
issues.required_revision: Index absence of line caps as a separate source configuration proposition on both platforms, while retaining every actual rendered wrapping/clipping obligation. A source statement cannot replace actual wrap evidence.

issues.title: Rectangular control and matching content-shape requirements are not fully routed
issues.rationale: The original primary label must fill a 56-unit rectangular native control allocation with a matching content shape. Current control-height/edge geometry and narrow fill samples do not establish complete silhouette, full label allocation or matching activation shape. The revised brief also requires status/primary with no rounded corners or borders, but no visual shape/border proposition exists. The status left-strip atom tests only one strip; it cannot establish the remaining perimeter. Ink rectangle shape likewise lacks a shape question.
issues.required_revision: Provide separate rendered shape/allocation questions for the required visible rectangular geometry, plus source-only matching-content-shape configuration/provenance where native APIs cannot measure it. Preserve actual control-edge and rendered-fill checks and make no physical-touch claim from AX boxes or Compose semantic OnClick.

issues.title: Noninteractive canvas, surface and ink mark are not explicitly covered
issues.rationale: Original API requires these three semantic nodes to be noninteractive. Existing source propositions require canvas/surface to preserve descendant Buttons and identifiers to be real/unique; these facts do not forbid activation actions on the containers or mark. Runtime label/pixel/geometry checks do not inspect absence of their native activation actions.
issues.required_revision: Add atomic source/native-semantic routes for noninteraction of canvas, surface and ink mark on each platform, retaining independent descendant native control preservation.

issues.title: T1 sampling-limit prose contains unrelated download constraints
issues.rationale: T1 BRIEF line 26 and reference sampling_limits/runtime mention exact-capacity equality and unmetered Wi-Fi-only downloads. Those concepts do not occur in the original T1 BRIEF/API or any T1 caller field and the T1 source guard audit contains only seal/coolant/request/acknowledgement logic. This appears to be unrelated prose and cannot count as T1 coverage.
issues.required_revision: Describe the actual T1 representative limits, including unsampled simultaneous seal/coolant holds covered by source precedence review. Do not change existing caller inputs or expectations.

remaining_limits: No SDK, simulator/emulator, native preview, app launch, product implementation or product screenshot was accessed. Generic synthetic callback/schema controls are tool tests only.

The proposed public runtime routes appear implementable on both platforms. Actual status/band semantic separation, unique native controls, full visibility, exact rendered inset, pixel mapping and scroll reachability remain unverified until authorized native probes/runs.

This review is scoped to design/T1 public. No independently fixed hidden caller inputs/direction were present there, and no hidden input or other task was read. Public LTR feasibility is not an approval of an unseen RTL contract.

Original raw v1 BRIEF/API were compared. Raw v1 fixtures and bridges were outside authorization, so original caller/bridge byte preservation could only be checked against the original digests recorded inside the revised reference and launch approval, not an independently opened v1 byte copy.

Definitions-only source audit is planning. Source-bound catalog/bind and real hash/line source judgments cannot pass before actual implementation exists. The source tool is a manual judgment binder, not AST/transitive dependency proof.

The unmodified source-audit module normally imports native-ui-agent/scripts. This review invoked its API with the permitted frozen candidate-v9 design_contract already imported and verified module identity; a separately pinned shared production invocation/dependency freeze and composite release adapter were not inspected under this scope.

Public cases are representative, not a Cartesian truth table. Both-false seal/coolant precedence and complete generic decision predicates are source-audited rather than claimed as native executions. Same-ID update behavior stays unspecified.

Original nominal computed SwiftUI typography/text-color/internal spacing tokens remain advisory. Exact rendered role samples, semantic native geometry, qualitative wrapping, overlap, clipping and hierarchy remain separate runtime MUSTs.
Hashes establish exact identity and reconstruction; they do not prove design authorship, reviewer independence beyond declared access, source proposition truth, native behavior or visual correctness.
actual_commands: command-log.jsonl plus SDK-free operator scripts and operator-notes.json
